data.name: Muhaddith
data.gender_notes: Muhaddith is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muhaddith is an Arabic name that refers to a scholar who specializes in the study and narration of Hadith, the sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Muhaddith carries the meaning “Scholar of Hadith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhaddith usually hope their child will grow to embody scholar of hadith and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A Muhaddith is a guardian of Islamic tradition and a keeper of the Prophet's legacy.
data.etymology: Muhaddith belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Scholar of Hadith.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhaddith total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: محدث
in_arabic.meaning: المحدث هو الشخص الذي يروي الحديث النبوي
in_arabic.long_meaning: المحدث هو الشخص الذي يروي الحديث النبوي ويفسره ويحفظه من التغيير أو التحريف، وهو شخص ذو علم ودراية بالسنة النبوية ويفهمها فهماً صحيحاً، ويعتبر المحدثون من أهم الشخصيات في علم الحديث النبوي.

in_urdu.name: محدث
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو حدیث نبوی کو روایت کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: محدث وہ شخص ہے جو حدیث نبوی کو روایت کرتا ہے، اس کی تشریح کرتا ہے، اور اسے محفوظ رکھتا ہے تاکہ وہ تبدیل یا تحریف نہ ہو، محدث علم و آگاہی کے حامل ہوتے ہیں اور سنت نبوی کو صحیح طور پر سمجھتے ہیں، اسلامی تاریخ و ثقافت میں محدثین کی بہت اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुहद्दिथ
in_hindi.meaning: वह व्यक्ति जो पैगंबर की हदीस को बयान करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहद्दिथ वह व्यक्ति है जो पैगंबर की हदीस को बयान करता है, उसकी व्याख्या करता है, और उसे सुरक्षित रखता है ताकि वह बदला या गलत न हो, मुहद्दिथ लोग विद्वान और ज्ञानी होते हैं और पैगंबर की सुन्नत को सही ढंग से समझते हैं, इस्लामी परंपरा में मुहद्दिथों का बहुत महत्व है।

in_pashto.name: محدث
in_pashto.meaning: هغه څوک چې د پېغمبر حديث بيانوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: محدث هغه څوک دی چې د پېغمبر حديث بيانوي، ده تعبير کوي، او هغه خوندي ساتي چې بدلون يا تحريف پکې نه رامنځ ته شي، محدثين علم او پوهاوي لرونکي دي او د پېغمبر سنت يې په سمه توګه پوهوي، د افغانستان او پښتون قوم په اسلامي تاريخ او کلتور کې محدثين ډېر اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Muhaddith
in_english.meaning: A person who narrates and interprets the Hadith of the Prophet
in_english.long_meaning: The term Muhaddith refers to a scholar who narrates, explains, and preserves the Hadith (sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad) with accuracy and authenticity. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-d-th' (حدث), meaning 'to happen' or 'to occur', the Muhaddith plays a critical role in Islamic scholarship, particularly in the field of Hadith studies. Throughout Islamic history, Muhaddiths have been essential in maintaining the integrity and transmission of Prophetic traditions.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: محدث (moohaddith)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: محدث (moohaddith)

data.cultural_impact: The title of Muhaddith carries great cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is a symbol of immense knowledge, dedication and piety. A Muhaddith is regarded as an authority on Hadith and plays a crucial role in preserving and transmitting the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to future generations.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Muhaddith holds profound spiritual significance as well, as it represents a deep connection to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his teachings. A Muhaddith is not just an academic scholar but also a spiritual guide, devoted to understanding and sharing the wisdom and guidance of the Prophet (PBUH) to help people lead virtuous lives according to Islamic principles. The title Muhaddith serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge, preserving tradition, and keeping the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) alive in the heart of the Muslim community.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muhaddith serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of scholar of hadith.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hajar al-Haytami (1504-1566) in Al-Dhahabi's Siyar A'lam an-Nubala mentions a scholar named Muhaddith Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Qasimi.
historical_references.context: Ibn Hajar al-Haytami was a prominent Egyptian scholar and historian.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Muhaddith remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Hassan Muhaddith, a teacher in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, shares that their name Muhaddith meaning "Scholar of Hadith" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
